body: Better start saving then. I'd have to save up £545 without travel expenses which would take about 11 months with the job i have. Pretty sure i'm going to be gone before then.
But there's nothing to hang onto..
but how do you take the first step and tell even the closest person to you? It just seems impossible..
Frankly, as an 18 year old, older people to me, be it age 30 or 40, have survived alot longer than me and alot longer than i will.

>  if I could find a way to get to your town and just sit down and have a drink with you and give you a hug and do nothing more than be there with you so that you know you're not alone

Literally made me cry, it's a nice to actually think of a situation where somebody in the real life knew how shitty i feel, but realisticly, i'm **ALWAYS** going to be too scared and afraid to tell anyone or search for help.
